🚀 INKINDI TECH

We are INKINDI TECH, an ambitious innovation team from Rwanda, driven by curiosity, creativity, technology, and the desire to solve real-world challenges.

Our interests include Artificial Intelligence (AI), space exploration, scientific innovation, education, and emerging technologies. We believe that great innovations begin with bold questions, creative thinking, and the determination to turn ideas into practical solutions.

INKINDI TECH — From Rwanda to the Universe. 🌍🚀
